purpose: One fresh-host smoke followed by one shared-client development B replay; no A recollection, held-out collection or model acceptance

collection_runtime.protocol_delivery: External immutable file; keep the collection checkout at the declared runtime commit
collection_runtime.verification: Operator verifies exact clean runtime commit before CPU acceptance; archive CPU acceptance, actual host/backend launch and protocol bytes. This field is not an extra runner-enforced gate.

qualification.on_failure: Retain all artifacts and stop; no automatic retry or threshold change. A later attempt requires a separately declared decision.

analysis_scope.runtime_pooling: Use shared-client A and B only; legacy per-request captures are diagnostic history, not this training series
analysis_scope.new_host: A and B may be on different rental hosts. Retain GPU/driver/runtime records; reversed schedule and one run per host do not isolate host drift or establish causal performance improvement.
analysis_scope.held_out: C remains unused; a separate frozen model acceptance declaration is required before any held-out collection
analysis_scope.claim: Measurement qualification and development identification data only; no MPC or model acceptance claim
